mapper.select: select i.ino, i.category, i.name, i.price, i.amount, i.discount, i.content, i.regDate, a.attachId, a.ino, a.filePath, a.fileName, a.fileType from item i left outer join attach a on i.ino = a.ino where 1 = 1
select ino, category, name, price, amount, discount, content from item where 1 = 1 and ino = #{ino}
select count(*) from item where 1 = 1 and ino > 0
select amount from item where 1 = 1 and ino = #{ino}
mapper.update: update item set name = #{name}, price = #{price}, category = #{category}, amount = #{amount}, discount = #{discount}, content = #{content} where 1 = 1 and ino = #{ino}
mapper.insert:
select nvl(max(ino), 0) + 1 from item
insert into item(ino, category, name, price, discount, content) values(#{ino}, #{category}, #{name}, #{price}, #{discount}, #{content})
